summary: Implemented the approved Formal Full Test contract by extending the existing DeliveryOperationPackage with an exact delivery-full-test variant, preserving project-declared check order, reusing existing applicable-check candidate/check/process identity mechanics without constructing an ActionPackage, requiring exact singleton authorize-formal-full-test Owner authority, and adding generic package-bound Full Test Guidance. Same-candidate prior PASS reuse requires exact candidate+checkRef equality; material check drift reruns affected checks; repository candidate drift stops terminal admission. No Registry/Planner/finding database/candidate invalidation subsystem/automatic correction-Git authority or Change 3–5 scope was introduced.
